Game Overview

In Nanychan vs Ghosts, the core idea is straightforward: join Nanychan on a spooky adventure in this 2D platformer. Navigate haunted levels, collecting red balls while avoiding eerie ghosts, spikes, and fire hazards. Master double jumps and quick reflexes to race against time in this Halloween-themed romp that balances simplicity with addictive challenge.
